findings.text: The specification permits `INSERT ... DEFAULT VALUES` in trigger bodies, but SQLite 3.51.0 rejects it at prepare time, as its [trigger documentation](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_createtrigger.html#syntax_restrictions_on_update_delete_and_insert_statements_within_triggers) specifies. Fix: remove this form from the supported bodies and require its syntax error.

The specification places all constraint checks after BEFORE triggers, but SQLite 3.51.0 checks STRICT column types before BEFORE INSERT triggers, so inserting text into an INTEGER column fails even when the trigger calls `RAISE(IGNORE)`. Fix: state the earlier type checks explicitly and include this case in the required conformance tests.
